Message:
ALSA: hda - add mic fixup for ALC269VB on Ordissimo EVE2

This fixes the internal and external mic on Ordissimo EVE2,  also known
as Malata PC-B1303.

We still don't know how to detect mic jack like Realtek's windows
driver.
